label: GAMEBOARD
comment: The standing world of the body round (HIGHLIGHTS.md, the owner's words of 2026-10-02, 17:40, 17:48 and 17:55: the body worlds of one kind, the engine advancing with the defined experiments as the research's check; the mathematician's 167, #1572 comment 5955538687, the standing world's blind, with the advisor's second hand, #1563 comment 5955658812 (C); the lay at the integer fixed point, 162 (3) and 168 item 2 (1); the resolution from a declared tolerance, 162 (1) and 168 item 1): one neutral body of the matter family (a real-profile mode, no sign holder read, so no odd lines and nothing signed) at the centre of the open 25-cube (an odd board, its centre a Node), laid by the generator at the integer fixed point under its own paces (the world's `lay` of the kind `fixed_point`: the record and the content re-laid in each other's paces until both repeat within `stop` units at every Node, inside `passes` passes), the same body in quanta at T = 2^15 (the rule's own universe, examples/events/rule.json) and at T = 2^19 (rule_2_19.json beside this design, the same rows), run for the same n intervals, 1000 (the owner's word of 19:28: n = 10^3 at both T where the two runs together fit about an hour, else the largest n that does, the same at both). The tolerance each world declares is the share's deviation the run may read, from which the loader derives the least T by the budget's line, T >= 32 num^2 n sin(omega_s) / (9 den^2 epsilon^2 c_i) (168 item 1), c_i the quanta per Node at the body's centre: [1, 32] at 2^15 and [1, 125] at 2^19 (at c_i = 79, the lay's quanta at the centre, the least T is 2^14 and 2^18, under the worlds' T; a tolerance a world cannot meet refuses it by name at load). The three reads, all GameBoard diagnostics by tools/body_standing.py (ENGINE.md section 5), the blind of each written here before any run and never edited after. What the short run does not test (163 (2), 165): the body's standing over long runs (the budget's 1 / sqrt(T) law is this world's own test, the standing beyond 10^3 intervals is not) and the line as a click (the giving or the absorption through a window, a round after this one). A ratio near 1 in read 2 instead of 4 is a T-free systematic, the lay's or the convention's (167): reported as a finding by name, never adjusted. The stop: the lay at the stop 1 (a fixed point to the unit) was asked first and refused by name at T = 2^15 after 30 passes, the map ending in a 2-cycle from the pass 16, the content's largest change 1 and the record's 2 at every pass with the count laid alternating 9,981 and 10,017 (the trajectory in the first lay's log, the finding of this world: the lay-and-rest map has no fixed point to the unit for this body in integers, the record's scale flipping between two neighbours); the stop declared here is the least the trajectory reached, 2 units at 2^15, and the same fraction of the amplitude at 2^19, 8 units, the levels there four times the 2^15 levels (A grows as sqrt T). THE 2^19 LAY, CUT: the lay of standing_19 at the stop 8 did not finish in 110 minutes of wall time and 89 minutes of CPU on a shared machine (its passes under the stop-1 refusal of the same body took 16 to reach the stop 2 at 2^15 in 7 minutes of CPU), and was stopped at the Boss's deadline of 22:15 Israel under the owner's word of 19:28 (whatever takes a lot of time, cut it); standing_19.json is shipped declared without a mode file, the loader refusing it at load by name as examples/events/matter_and_binding/pair.json is shipped, and the blind's ratio rho_s(2^15) / rho_s(2^19) stands unread, to be read when the 2^19 lay is run to its end. The blind restated for a real mode (the mathematician's 172, #1572 comment 5959853571, with the advisor's second hand, #1563 comment 5960096992; the owner's word of 2026-10-03, 00:47, fix everything that was found; written before any re-run, the rows of 167 kept beside as the dated record): read 2 on the law's own static quantity per Node, the form D_i = now^2 - next x before (the count is the record's share), A_i^2 sin^2 omega exactly for one real mode at every interval, so rho_D = sqrt(SUM (D_i(n) - D_i(0))^2 / SUM D_i(0)^2) over the body's declared Nodes reads the walk and the lay alone where rho_s on the levels' squares reads the real mode's own breathing at 2 omega first; read 3 summed over the body and over a window of whole periods, exact for one mode with no singular interval, where the per-interval summed read is near-singular twice a period (every Node of a real mode crossing 0 at once), the spread 7.2 x 10^-3 read before being those intervals and no drift; the rows `form_deviation` and `rotation_windows` below, the body's own numbers under `from_the_lay` (`rho_d_expected`, twice `rho_s_expected` at each quarter, and `rotation_window_noise`). The blind restated again before the re-read on the fixed engine (the mathematician's 175, #1572 comment 5962582859, items 3 and 7, with the advisor's 5962061454; the Boss's word relayed): after the rest's fix the line at 1 / 52 must vanish and after the write's fix the 48 images hold to the bit over the whole run; what remains in rho_D is two parts, the walk, 11.3 sigma sqrt(n) / A within 5 percent with the sqrt(n) ratio 2 within 5 percent (the blind, pass or fail), and the lay's beat at 1 / 185 (Delta omega = 0.034, the neighbouring mode's admixture, T-free), reported as the Fourier weight of that line and not blinded, the lay at today's integer fixed point carrying it by construction; read 2 passes when the walk's part sits within 5 percent of 11.3 sigma sqrt(n) / A once the beat's line is subtracted, a third part a finding by name; the T ratio is read at 2^17 and not at 2^19 (the lay at 2^19 cost 89 minutes of CPU unfinished): standing_17 declared here on rule_2_17.json (rule.json's rows at T = 2^17), the tolerance [1, 64] (rho_s's expectation halves as A doubles; the least T by the budget's line 2^16 at c_i = 79) and the stop 4 (the same fraction of the amplitude, A twice the 2^15 lay's), to be laid and run on the fixed engine, the blind's ratio rho_D(2^15) / rho_D(2^17) = 2.00 within 5 percent on the walk's part and 1 on the beat's; if the 2^17 lay is still long, the sqrt(n) law within the 2^15 run alone separates the walk from the beat with the Fourier line and the T ratio is left for the morning by name.

sigma.formula: sigma = (num / (3 den)) sqrt(6 / 12) levels per interval per Node at the vacuum's paces (S = 0 there), the rms of the six reads' fractions and the Node's own; at the body's own paces the same expression in the Node's R_ij, S and w, S / w of the order of U (167, 168)

reading: per world (tools/body_standing.py, GameBoard): (1) the centroid of the body's share along each axis at the window's ends and its drift (the centroid tools/body_drift.py reads along a chain, here per axis with the density summed over the other two); (2) the deviation over the body's declared Nodes of the form D_i = now^2 - next x before, rho_D^2 = SUM (D_i(k) - D_i(0))^2 / SUM D_i(0)^2 at every form centre k (the form at k from z_(k - 1), z_k, z_(k + 1), the lay's own form at 0 the reference, the window's last centre one before its end) and at the quarters, rho_D the fixed point of the division act at the scale T, its series' envelope (the local maxima and their spacings) at the interval scale and over the means of successive windows of one period, the beat's read, and with --beat-period the Fourier line of the series at the beat's period in floats (the beat's weight, not blinded) with the series less the line at the quarters, the walk's part; beside it rho_s^2 = SUM (s_n - s_0)^2 / SUM s_0^2 on the share per Node at the paces of the read, 167's convention, the real mode's own breathing at 2 omega, at the quarters with its series' maxima and spacings; (3) the rotation over windows of whole periods, 2 cos omega_read = SUM over the window of SUM over the body of z_t (z_(t + 1) + z_(t - 1)) / the same double sum of z_t^2, the period in whole intervals from the mode file's clock pair by the rotation's own recurrence (2 cos omega = clock[0] / clock[1]), per successive window and over the whole run, the windows' least, largest and spread and the window series' envelope; beside it the per-interval read cos omega_read = SUM z_t (z_(t + 1) + z_(t - 1)) / (2 SUM z_t^2), near-singular twice a period for a real mode, its least and largest over the intervals where the record's weight 2 SUM z_t^2 is at least half its largest and the window's accumulated ratio; (4) the cube's 48 images after every interval, the interval through which they held and the first departure named; the books at the end.

drift.reading: read (1): the centroid's drift per axis at the window's ends, in Links
drift.blind: each |delta x_c| below 3 x its rms, 2 sigma sqrt(n) rho_x / (A sqrt(N_eff)) with N_eff = SUM f^2 and rho_x^2 = SUM x^2 f^2 / SUM f^2 over the lay's profile f (A f the level per Node); the 2^15 drift larger than the 2^19 one in about 0.84 of the components; for 163's body (a_0 = 14 Links, N_eff = 8620) 1.8 x 10^-3 Links at n = 10^3 and 2^15 and 4.4 x 10^-4 at 2^19; a single centroid is one draw, so this read is loose by nature and no test
drift.status: 167 (1), the formula from the remainder term's walk, sigma sqrt(n) levels after n intervals against the amplitude A; the body's own numbers under `from_the_lay` from the mode file's profile, before any run

share_deviation.reading: read (2) as 167 wrote it, kept beside the restated read: rho_s on the levels' squares at n and at n / 4 in each world
share_deviation.blind: rho_s = (2 sigma sqrt(n) / A) sqrt(SUM f^2 / SUM f^4), 5.66 sigma sqrt(n) / A for the exponential profile: 3.3 percent at n = 10^3 and T = 2^15 and 0.82 percent at 2^19 for 163's body (c_i about 33); the tests: rho_s(2^15) / rho_s(2^19) = 4 within 5 percent (between 3.8 and 4.2) at equal n, since A grows as sqrt(T) and sigma is T-free, and within one run rho_s(n) / rho_s(n / 4) = 2 within 5 percent, the sqrt(n) law; a ratio near 1 in either is a T-free systematic, the lay's (the body breathing about a fixed point it was not laid at) or the convention's, a finding by name
share_deviation.status: 167 (2) with the advisor's recomputation, 5955658812 (C): sigma^2 = 6 (2 / 9)^2 / 12 at [2, 3], sqrt(SUM f^2 / SUM f^4) = sqrt 8 for e^(-r / a_0), the scatter 1 / sqrt(2 N_eff) about 1 percent per read; the body's own expectation under `from_the_lay`; restated by 172 on the form D (`form_deviation`): for a real mode rho_s reads the mode's own breathing at 2 omega first, the convention's systematic the first reading named
